```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

data <- read_excel("/Users/octaannachellejovanah/assignments/Youth-unemployment PBA project.xlsx")
head(data)
colnames(data)
str(data)
nrow(data)
colSums(is.na(data))
data %>%
  filter(is.na(min_wage))
#Clean the data
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year),
    unemployment_rate = as.numeric(unemployment_rate),
    min_wage = as.numeric(min_wage)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = ifelse(
      state %in% c("California", "New York", "Washington"), 1, 0
    ),
    post = ifelse(year >= 2021, 1, 0),
    did = treatment * post
  )

#Youth unemployment trends, 2018–2024
plot_data <- data %>%
  group_by(year, age_group, treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_unemployment = mean(unemployment_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group = ifelse(
      treatment == 1,
      "Treatment group",
      "Comparison group"
    )
  )
ggplot(plot_data,
       aes(x = year,
           y = avg_unemployment,
           color = group,
           group = group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2020.5,
             linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ age_group) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2018:2024) +
  labs(
    title = "Youth Unemployment Trends by Treatment Group",
    subtitle = "2018–2024",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Average unemployment rate (%)",
    color = "State group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

#Minimum wage trends by state
ggplot(data,
       aes(x = year,
           y = min_wage,
           color = state,
           group = state)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2020.5,
             linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2018:2024) +
  labs(
    title = "Minimum Wage Trends Across Six States",
    subtitle = "2018–2024",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Minimum wage ($ per hour)",
    color = "State"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

#Individual State Youth Unemployment Trends (2018–2024)
ggplot(data, aes(x = year,
                 y = unemployment_rate,
                 color = state,
                 group = state)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2020.5,
             linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ age_group) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2018:2024) +
  labs(
    title = "Youth Unemployment Trends by State",
    subtitle = "2018–2024",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Unemployment rate (%)",
    color = "State"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

#Treatment-control unemployment gap over time
gap_data <- plot_data %>%
  select(year, age_group, treatment, avg_unemployment) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = treatment,
    values_from = avg_unemployment,
    names_prefix = "group_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    gap = group_1 - group_0
  )

ggplot(gap_data,
       aes(x = year, y = gap)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
             linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2020.5,
             linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ age_group) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2018:2024) +
  labs(
    title = "Youth Unemployment Gap Between State Groups",
    subtitle = "Treatment group minus comparison group",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Unemployment gap (percentage points)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
